observations: Photo 0: Used automotive alternator unit, dusty/dirty casing, viewed from the pulley-adjacent side, watermark reads 'U-ZION LINKS AUTO'S'.
Photo 1: Same unit from the pulley end, showing cooling fan and mounting ears with bolt holes.
Photo 2: Same unit from the opposite side, showing the serpentine belt pulley/grooves and electrical connector housing.
No brand, part number, or vehicle application markings are visible on the casing in any photo.
No photo shows the unit connected to a battery or spinning to demonstrate charging output.
Surface shows oxidation, grime, and general wear consistent with a used/removed part.

claims.claim: Also deals on all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: General business claim, not about this specific item; no photo can confirm scope of seller's inventory.

risks.risk: Alternator may not actually charge or spin freely (no functional test shown).
risks.proof: A video clip of the alternator spinning on a bench test rig or rig showing voltage output on a multimeter.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for parts only

risks.risk: Unknown vehicle fitment/compatibility since no part number or vehicle make is given.
risks.proof: A clear photo of any stamped part number or OEM sticker on the casing, or seller statement of exact vehicle make/model/year it was pulled from.

risks.risk: Internal brush, bearing, or regulator wear not visible from outside.
risks.proof: Photo/video of internal components or a bench test showing stable voltage under load.

risks.risk: Corrosion or belt pulley wear affecting usability.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of pulley grooves and belt contact surface.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic wear, no discount beyond visible dirt/oxidation already seen

proof_requests: Video of the alternator spinning with a drill or bench rig showing voltage output.
Close-up photo of any stamped part number or OEM label on the housing.
Statement of exact make/model/year of vehicle this was removed from.
Close-up of the electrical connector pins for corrosion or damage.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used car alternator from the photos, but with no part number, no vehicle fitment, and no functional test shown, it must be priced at worst case as an untested, generic used alternator.
